description: Resolve an Autonomous System Number (ASN) to its org name, country, and RIR source via RIR RDAP. Accepts AS-prefixed format (e.g., "AS15169") or bare integer (e.g., "15169"). Distinct from IP lookup — the entry point is the ASN itself, not an IP within its block.

asn.description: Autonomous System Number to look up. Accepts AS-prefixed format (e.g., "AS15169") or bare integer (e.g., "15169").

name: whois_lookup_asn

country.description: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Omitted when not in RDAP data.

end_autnum.description: End ASN of the registered range.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_asn`: Input does not match AS<number> or bare integer format. `asn_not_found`: RDAP returned 404 — ASN not found in any RIR. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

org_name.description: Organization name registered for this ASN.

rir.description: Regional Internet Registry that manages this ASN (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC).

start_autnum.description: Start ASN of the registered range.

title: ASN Lookup
